title: Crisp Paella Casserole
description: A hearty German twist on the traditional Spanish dish, using crispy casabe and savory portuguese sausage.
instructions: Cook crushed casabe in a skillet over medium heat until lightly toasted.
Cook sausage in a large skillet over medium-high heat until browned, breaking into small pieces.
Add onion, garlic, and tomato to skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Stir in paella rice and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Transfer the mixture to a greased 9x13-inch baking dish.
Top with shredded cheddar cheese and crumbled bacon.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Stir in salsa verde and serve hot.
Garnish with crisp, fresh parsley if desired.
